title: How to prevent Uniswap buys from being front-run by MEV bots using OptiSwap
description: OptiSwap uses a different method for calculating slippage, which can help keep whale money in your liquidity pool https://optiswap.pro/about https://discord.gg/rn5BVHG4t3

asr.full_text: Slippage tolerance is usually set as a percentage of your overall order size. For small orders it works. For example, a 1% margin on a small order isn't large enough for bots to break even on the transaction fees. But for larger orders, 1% can turn into an attractive amount that's up for grabs. OptySwap is an improved Uniswap interface that specifies slippage in absolute terms instead of relative. It doesn't matter if your order is small or huge, you can keep a tight tolerance and avoid having value drained. Even for tax tokens that usually require manual slipperage settings. Up to swap incorporates the tax automatically, so no change is required. Along with optimized gas usage, order analysis, and one-click optimization, OptiSwap is the ideal tool for Uniswap traders.
